about: Answer key for the skill catalog (scripts/eval/skill-catalog.ts). Question ids are from the 2026-11-04 production snapshot. The hard tier is scored: Devin's approved groups (2026-11-05), adjusted for his split of the AI questions into supervised coding and unsupervised processes. The open tier is reported, not scored: Devin wants to see where these land. Cases are new requirements distilled against a catalog applied from a plan; 'with' names a question whose skill the case must map to, 'not' names questions whose skills it must not map to. Cases added 2026-11-06 ('from' names the 2026-11-05 snapshot question the wording came from; ids above 363 are not in the 2026-11-04 snapshot): Devin's two open cards that he called the same question (#391 and #427, both 'Using AI in unsupervised processes', #153), the other wordings the ask-time distill made new LLM skills for, and three production skill names whose postings are not in a snapshot (worded from the skill name). 'with' may list several ids when an existing skill is at least as close: #357 'LLM architecture, RAG, or AI agents' for #427's wording, #199 'LLM tool use and function calling' for tool calling, #195 'Using AI to build product features' for AI in product features. 'llmDuplicates' is the key for the one-time repair (scripts/eval/llm-skill-repair.ts): distill-created skills that fold into #153's skill, and the ones left for Devin.
